pages.summary: Ginny llega con James y Harry saluda a los Granger. Pansy advierte que Malcolm mira a Harry con más reserva.

panels.scene: Close Jane holds Robin in her arms in front of the brick wall. He taps her nose with one tiny index finger, and Malcolm leans in beside them, softening.
panels.caption: Hasta Malcolm se olvidó por un instante de sus reservas.

panels.scene: Wide view down the platform. Ginny walks briskly in ochre, carrying exactly one black-haired cream-clad baby on her hip. Harry with round glasses catches up, burdened with bags. An open space ahead and vapor behind.

Ginny and Jane greet with warm smiles and a brief shoulder touch. Each baby's face stays apart, Robin navy with brown curls on Jane’s right arm, James cream with black curls on Ginny’s left arm. Two babies total.
Harry in navy coat sets one suitcase on the paving and raises his head to greet. He is clearly a young human with rounded glasses, no resemblance to Malcolm’s rectangular glasses.
Jane turns warmly toward Harry, still supports Robin. Malcolm gives a short, restrained nod. Pansy in partial profile watches the difference with one eyebrow raised.
dialogue: Jane: Puedes llamarnos Jane y Malcolm, cariño.

panels.scene: Ginny turns to Hermione and Pansy with an affectionate teasing grin, James seated securely on her hip. Pansy and Hermione retain distinct hair and coats.
dialogue: Ginny: ¿Ya les contaste todas tus preguntas sobre el mundo muggle?

pages.summary: Ante la camioneta de los Granger, Pansy preferiría una escoba. Jane les muestra el asiento que instalaron para Robin.

panels.scene: Wide establishing exterior as the four people leave the brick station in cold sunset. Malcolm pushes the trolley with two large trunks and one small. Jane supports Robin, Hermione and Pansy follow.
panels.caption: El aire helado de Londres los recibió al salir.

panels.scene: Low angle from next to the rear wheel of a graphite gray SUV at the curb. Pansy stares suspiciously at the massive dark gray vehicle, arms naturally folded over her charcoal coat.
dialogue: Pansy: No pienso subirme a esa cosa, Granger.

panels.scene: Hermione looks at her with gentle amusement from the sidewalk. Pansy stands upright, thoughtful green eyes and no wand in her hands.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Y cómo piensas llegar a casa?

panels.scene: Malcolm raises the open tailgate and sets the small trunk beside the two larger ones in the cargo area. Jane and Robin stay near the closed rear passenger door, safely away from trunks.
dialogue: Malcolm: Eso no me tranquiliza mucho, Pansy.

panels.scene: Hermione touches Pansy's wool sleeve lightly with one hand, the other tucked in her coat pocket. Their honest expressions and warmer streetlamp light. The car remains in the background.
dialogue: Hermione: Confía en mí. En media hora estaremos en casa.

panels.scene: Jane opens the stationary car's rear passenger door and angles her head toward one empty rear-facing infant seat centered on the back row, Robin safely in her opposite arm. Pansy leans slightly to see, clearly outside.
dialogue: Jane: Malcolm revisó la silla tres veces.
